jobs.description:
Our client is a distinguished leader in the fine watch and luxury industry, renowned for craftsmanship and timeless excellence.
They are now looking for a driven Sales Executive Benelux, capable of elevating their commercial network and fostering long-term relationships.

Jobomschrijving

The Sales Executive Benelux will have the following responsibilities :

• Manage and develop relationships with the brand distribution network across the Benelux region.
• Conduct regular visits to points of sale to ensure operational excellence, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
• Build strong partnerships with retailers and act as the main point of contact for the brands.
• Maintain and actively manage CRM systems, ensuring accurate reporting and customer data management.
• Oversee visual merchandising standards to guarantee optimal brand image, visibility, and in-store presentation.
• Organize and deliver commercial training sessions for sales teams, focusing on product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer experience.
• Stay up to date with new product launches, brand developments, and watch market trends to effectively support and coach retail partners.

• First relevant experience in Retail or a Field Sales experience is expected
• Strong affinity for the watches industry
• Presentation and communication skills
• Client-driven, sense of service, attention to details
• Analytical skills
• Dutch native, Fluent in French and English

As Sales Account Manager Export, you will be responsible for expanding and strengthening our business across international markets outside Western Europe. 
 

You will focus primarily on developing relationships with large customers and distributors, ensuring sustainable growth and long-term partnerships.
 

You combine a strategic outlook with a hands-on approach to drive sales performance and unlock new opportunities.
 

Key responsibilities: 
 

•    Develop and manage relationships with key accounts and international distributors

•    Drive sales growth across export markets outside Western Europe

•    Identify and develop new business opportunities in assigned regions

•    Negotiate commercial agreements and contracts 

•    Set-up, manage, motivate, and support a network of agents

•    Monitor sales performance and ensure targets are achieved

•    Analyze market trends and customer needs to define growth strategies

•    Collaborate closely with internal teams including marketing, customer service, and supply chain

•    Represent the company at international trade fairs and customer meetings

•    You will translate internal commercial strategies into action and continuously improve the end-to-end sales process via our CRM platform (Dynamics 365). 

•    Proven experience in an international sales or export role

•    Strong experience managing key accounts and/or distributors

•    Commercially driven with excellent negotiation skills

•    Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented

•    Strong communication and relationship-building skills

•    Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus)

•    Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis

Are you a driven Sales & Recruitment Officer with a passion for consultative, high-level sales? Do you want to make a real impact by selling top-tier MBA programs to ambitious professionals and executives? Then this opportunity in Brussels is for you.

About the Role
As a Sales & Recruitment Officer– MBA Programs, you will be responsible for attracting and enrolling candidates into prestigious, international MBA and Executive Education programs (including HEC Paris).

This is a true hunter role, where you proactively generate new business through outbound activities such as cold calling, networking, events, and strategic relationship building.

Key Responsibilities
 
• Proactively generate leads and new business for MBA and executive education programs 
• Advise professionals and senior executives on career development through MBA pathways 
• Build and maintain strong relationships with C-level and high-potential candidates 
• Organize and follow up on events, info sessions, and networking opportunities 
• Achieve and exceed commercial targets in Brussels and Flanders 
• Develop strategic partnerships with companies and organizations
Your Profile
 
• Proven experience in B2B sales or consultative selling, ideally involving high-value solutions (€35K+) 
• Strong interest in education, executive learning, or MBA programs 
• A true hunter mindset with a passion for generating new opportunities 
• Experience engaging with senior stakeholders and decision-makers 
• Good understanding of the Belgian market (Brussels & Flanders)
Skills & Competencies
 
• Excellent communication and influencing skills in English (C1+) 
• Dutch and/or French is a strong asset 
• Strong prospecting, networking, and relationship-building skills 
• Commercially driven with strategic thinking abilities 
• Ability to translate career goals into tailored MBA solutions 
• Bachelor's degree
Personality
 
• Ambitious, energetic, and highly results-driven 
• Resilient and persistent, with strong closing skills 
• Consultative mindset: you guide candidates through a key life decision 
• Self-starter, independent, and entrepreneurial 
• Motivated by impact, ownership, and career growth opportunities

Are you an Inside Sales Representative with experience in the food industry and strong language skills in English plus German, Danish, Swedish or Portuguese? Apply today and join an international trading environment.

Your role as an Inside Sales Representative
For an international company active in the food sector, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to support and expand commercial relationships within the meat industry. As a Sales Support Specialist and Internal Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing customer relationships and ensuring smooth follow-up of the entire sales process.

Your responsibilities:
 
• Manage and develop an existing customer portfolio. 
• Prepare, send and follow up on quotations. 
• Maintain regular contact with restaurants, hotels and retail customers. 
• Identify commercial opportunities and support business growth. 
• Coordinate customer requests and monitor deliveries. 
• Participate in trade fairs and industry events when required. 
• Collaborate closely with internal teams and international partners.
Your profile as an Inside Sales Representative / Internal Account Manager
 
• You have experience in an inside sales, sales support, customer service or commercial administration role. 
• Experience in the food industry. 
• Experience within the meat sector is considered a significant advantage. 
• You communicate fluently in English and at least one of the following languages: German, Danish, Swedish or Portuguese.

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.

Loading and unloading roll containers.

As a Group Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA) Audit & Certification Assistant, you will provide administrative, analytical, and reporting support for food safety audits and certification programs across our international production sites.
 
 

• Coordinate food safety, sustainability, religious, ethical, and customer-specific certification schemes across the Group. 

• Monitor certification statuses, audit schedules, renewal timelines, and maintain accurate compliance records and databases. 

• Support the planning, administration, documentation, and follow-up of internal and external audits across production sites. 

• Develop and maintain KPI dashboards, reporting tools, and perform trend analyses to support data-driven decision-making. 

• Track audit findings and corrective actions, ensuring timely follow-up and closure. 

• Provide administrative and analytical support for continuous improvement projects, annual program reviews, and FSQA initiatives. 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• A Bachelor's degree in a food-related or data-analytical field. 

• Experience in an administrative or support role within a technical, quality, or food industry environment. 

• Strong reporting and data management skills, with advanced knowledge of MS Office applications. 

• Experience with databases, KPI reporting, dashboards, and data visualization tools; knowledge of auditing and certification schemes is a strong asset. 

• Professional proficiency in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus. 

• A detail-oriented, analytical, and structured mindset, combined with flexibility, independence, and a positive attitude.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!

• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.

• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.

• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.

• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.

• You have a very good knowledge of English.

You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

As an Import & Export Coordinator at Lotus Bakeries, you play a key role in ensuring the seamless flow of goods across international markets. You coordinate import and export shipments, manage customs processes, and work closely with logistics partners, internal stakeholders, and customs authorities.
 

As part of the Import & Export team you will:
 
 

• Coordinate and manage international import and export shipments across multiple transport modes (ocean, road, air, and multimodal), ensuring timely delivery while optimizing logistics flows to balance service, cost, and operational requirements. 

• Prepare and submit import and export customs declarations in-house or in collaboration with customs brokers, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable regulations. Manage communication with local customs authorities and internal compliance teams to facilitate efficient customs clearance and the timely resolution of customs-related issues. 

• Monitor transport performance and proactively resolve issues such as delays, demurrage, detention, and other operational disruptions. 

• Maintain accurate shipping and customs documentation and follow up on discrepancies or corrective actions when needed. 

• Ensure accurate data entry and management across logistics and customs systems, including master data maintenance and customs decision tables in CAS, while safeguarding data quality, integrity, and compliance. 

• Act as the key operational contact for shipment-related questions and escalations and support the implementation of new logistics and customs processes. 
 

• You have a Bachelor or Master degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Transport, Customs, or a related field. 

• A (first) experience with international freight flows and customs formalities has given you a good understanding of ocean, road, and air transport. 

• With your strong organizational and communication skills in both Dutch & English, you are able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining an accurate and detail-oriented approach. 

• Working independently comes naturally to you, while you also enjoy collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to achieve shared goals. 

• A proactive, hands-on, and customer-focused mindset helps you adapt to changing priorities and remain effective under pressure. 

• You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office, and experience with SAP S/4 or customs systems is considered a plus. 

• Your genuine interest in international supply chain, trade, and customs motivates you to continuously learn and develop in this field.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.

• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.

• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.

• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  

• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  

• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Join a growing and international environment where you play a key role in maintaining a compliant document management process. As a Document Control Specialist, you will:

What will you do?

Coordinate, manage, and maintain critical documentation and administrative processes within the organization.

Ensure administrative activities are executed accurately and in compliance with internal procedures.

Support multiple teams by helping to coordinate tasks and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

Assist during audits and maintain correct documentation, records, and archiving.

Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize and streamline administrative workflows.

Act as a point of contact between departments to ensure clear communication and timely information flow.

You stay calm, focused, and structured, even when handling multiple tasks simultaneously.

You have a strong eye for detail and take full ownership of your responsibilities, always aiming for high-quality results.

You are comfortable working independently but also thrive in a collaborative team environment.

You adapt quickly to changing priorities and manage your workload efficiently without compromising accuracy.

Strong organizational and time-management skills are essential, as well as the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

You are proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).

You communicate fluently in spoken and written English.

Experience in a pharmaceutical or GMP-regulated environment is an asset, but not a requirement.

LVO Industries is a permanent capital holding company. We acquire family-owned and owner-operated businesses and partner with them to ensure their long-term success. At LVO, you’ll join a small, dynamic team operating in an entrepreneurial environment.
 

Role & Responsibilities :
As CTO, you are the digital control tower of the LVO group, responsible for the digital aspects of every portfolio company: Odoo, AI, software development and the Microsoft stack. You bring strong engineering and real AI expertise, set the standards, and make sure the right technology choices and practices are followed everywhere. The job is as much about coaching the teams as building IT solutions yourself in Odoo, AI and beyond. Your responsibilities will evolve over time, and will at least include:
 
 

• make sure all digital tools (Odoo, AI agents, the Microsoft stack, other third-party software) are well chosen and used to their full potential across teams. 

• ensure the IT teams are highly efficient and well-functioning, coaching them on engineering and AI best practices, code quality and testing. 

• drive the development of AI agents to accelerate automation, improve customer satisfaction and replace costly tools, building them yourself and enabling the POs and IT teams to build and run them. 

• implement, follow up and continuously optimize Odoo across the portfolio companies. 

• oversee the broader technical foundation: hosting, architecture, cybersecurity, testing and data. 

• help select external providers and partners, and make sure they deliver.  

Success means a digital strategy that performs across the group: strong automation, a better experience for staff and customers, solid cybersecurity, and technology that is future-proof and cost-effective.

Mindset :
More than anything else, we are looking for a candidate with a positive attitude, who is:
 
 

• a builder who codes and configures as naturally as they advise 

• a teacher at heart who leaves teams stronger than they found them 

• obsessed with using AI and automation to remove friction 

• comfortable carrying influence without a title to back it up 

• self-starting, pragmatic, allergic to needless process 

• at ease jumping between companies, stacks and roles 

• dependable: says what they'll do, then does it  

Requirements :
 
 

• a genuine developer and IT engineer background (degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent): you have built and shipped software yourself, stay hands-on with code, and are comfortable across the stack from application architecture to hosting, cybersecurity and automated testing 

• between 5 and 10 years implementing IT and automation projects, including ERP set-ups, in small and medium-sized businesses. 

• real depth in AI: hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-based solutions, and a clear view on applying AI best practices in a business context 

• able to be based in Brussels (Watermael-Boitsfort) and to travel within Belgium. 

• strong written and verbal communication skills in Dutch, French and English

Our client in the Netherlands, distributor in equipment, consumables and reagents for life sciences industry and universities, we are looking for a Sales manager (Brussels/Wallonia/ Luxemburg region) for a permanent position.
 

Verantwoordelijkheden
 
 

• After training of the products and equipment, you will be further guided by an experienced manager in the field to introduce the products to new and existing customers in the life science market. 

• You visit new customers and maintain contacts with existing customers.You listen to their needs, give advice and negotiate price proposals 

• You supervise and follow up demos of equipment / kits with customers in collaboration with the specialists. 

• You visit fairs, participate in seminars or webinars. 

• You meet your colleagues (1 day per month) at the office for team meetings, new product launches, administrative tasks, team building, etc 

• You report to the sales and marketing manager 

Vereisten
 
 

• You have a bachelor or master degree in biochemistry, biotechnology or you have relevant experience in a similar sales position. 

• You have a commercial attitude and you are communicative. 

• You have affinity with biotechnology lab equipment, consumables, reagents. 

• You can organize yourself, you are creative and can take initiative. 

• You speak and write fluently French and English and have a good knowledge of Dutch (is a plus).

The R&I Policy Officer will support CLERENS in their work for the Batteries European Partnership Association (BEPA). BEPA represents the battery innovation community in Brussels, representing both industry and research members. BEPA is the private partner in the Horizon Europe Batt4EU Partnership with the European Commission.

In close cooperation with the Secretary General and other BEPA team members, the consultant will help BEPA transition from the current Horizon Europe framework to the new R&I ecosystem that will come with the new EU budget. The R&I Policy Officer will bring strong technical expertise in batteries to support multiple BEPA Technical Working Groups and/or Task Forces. These working groups range in size from 50 to almost 200 battery experts and prepare the official inputs given by BEPA to the European Commission on the strategic direction of battery research within the Horizon Europe Programme and beyond.

Main Duties:

¿            You lead the operational management of BEPA Working Groups and Task Forces, working alongside chairs and co-chairs to ensure outputs are delivered on time. You own the agenda, drive discussions, present updates, and coordinate the dissemination of information.

¿            Support, together with the Secretary General and Executive Director, the monthly meetings of the Executive Board meetings, by preparing and following up on the strategic decisions taken;

¿            Contribute, in terms of content and organisation, to BEPA events, like the General Assembly and the Battery Innovation Days, and smaller events like technical workshops and matchmaking events;

¿            Actively engage with the BEPA members. Follow up on enquiries by current members, engage with prospective members by conducting proactive outreach activities and welcoming new members into the organisation;

¿            Support the BEPA Communication Officer by providing content for BEPA publications (e.g. newsletter, website, social media, etc.);
 
¿            University or advanced degree (doctorat) in battery or electrochemical engineering, electrochemistry, (battery) materials science, or a closely related technical field.

¿            In-depth technical knowledge of the battery sector: battery science, cell chemistry, materials, manufacturing, and system integration, combined with a solid understanding of the industry landscape, markets, value chains, and key players.

¿            Between 3-5 years of relevant experience in battery or energy-related R&I, whether in industry, a research institution, or a European association; experience with EU-funded innovation projects is an asset.

¿            Good knowledge of the workings of the European Union, in particular in the sphere of research and innovation (Horizon Europe); previous experience engaging with EU institutions or R&I policy is an asset.

¿            Ability to quickly grasp new topics and process information effectively, and to put thoughts into actions quickly.

¿            Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with attention to detail.

¿            Capacity to collect, organise and analyse quantitative and qualitative data.

¿            Ability to plan and work independently, manage stress, multiple deadlines and effectively prioritise workload.

¿            Fluency in English is necessary; any additional European language is an asset.

¿            Proficiency in MS Office applications is a must; acquaintance with other software is a strong advantage.
 
¿            The opportunity to work for a great European initiative concretely supporting the clean energy transition.

¿            A challenging, multi-faceted role in a dynamic team with room to grow and take on additional responsibilities.

¿            A stimulating and dynamic international environment.

 

Applications

To apply, please send a motivation letter and CV in English to the HR Manager, Eftychia Michailidou at hr@clerens.eu with ¿BEPA - R&I Policy Officer¿ in the subject line.

 

Be aware that applications are reviewed continuously upon arrival; therefore, applying as soon as possible is advisable. Due to the expected high number of applications, only short-listed candidates will be contacted for interviews.

Kick-start your career in marketing operations, client services and project coordination!

Are you a recent graduate or have had a positive first work experience in a marketing services environment and looking for a role where you can learn fast, take ownership, work with clients in an international environment, and make a real impact from day one?

Our client is looking for an enthusiastic and driven Program Coordinator to join their Belgian team in Hasselt.

This hybrid role combines client communication, project coordination and related admin (quotations, invoicing), vendor communications, operational coordination and process improvement within a dynamic B2B direct marketing environment focused on print, fulfillment and logistics services.

You'll work closely with experienced colleagues who will support, coach and train you while giving you the opportunity to grow into a trusted client and operations professional. We are looking for someone with common sense, energy, curiosity, and a proactive mindset. Someone

who communicates openly and clearly, takes ownership, and challenges the status quo when a better solution exists. 

A forward thinker who anticipates obstacles, identifies opportunities, and consistently stays one step ahead. Comfortable working independently, making sound decisions, and driving initiatives forward with limited supervision, while also recognizing the value of collaboration and actively contributing to a strong team environment. Someone who thrives on solving problems, improving processes, and turning challenges into opportunities for growth and success.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment, build strong relationships with colleagues and clients, and bring a practical, can-do approach to business challenges. While previous experience in a similar role is an advantage, we place greater value on attitude, drive, pro-activeness, learning agility, and the potential to make a meaningful impact from day one. No two days are the same. One day you might be coordinating a client project, the next day you could be visiting our warehouse partners, analysing operational performance, or identifying opportunities to improve processes and customer experience.

During your first years with our client, you'll gain experience in: 

 
• Client relationship management 
 
• Project coordination 
 
• Marketing operations 
 
• Print and fulfillment services 
 
• Vendor and warehouse coordination 
 
• Business process improvement 
 
• Data analysis and reporting 
 
• Operational excellence 
 
• Cross-functional collaboration

Experts in defining, executing, and optimizing the customer journey, they offer end-to-end marketing services including consulting, strategic assessment, data, analytics, digital, social, mobile, print, fulfillment, logistics and contact center
solutions.

• Looking for a first professional role with growth opportunities

• Naturally proactive, eager to take ownership, and driven to deliver results without waiting to be
asked 
 
• Strong pro-active communicator who enjoys working with both colleagues and clients 
 
• Analytical mindset with an eye for detail 
 
• Curious and solution-oriented 
 
• Comfortable challenging existing processes and proposing improvements 
 
• Able to combine structured thinking with practical execution 
 
• Positive attitude and willingness to learn 
 
• Not afraid to roll up your sleeves when needed and take the extra mile to make it happen 
 
• Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 applications

Our client is a global marketing services organization specializing in multi-channel B2B & B2C marketing solutions that connect their clients with their customers in powerful ways. solutions.

Program & Client Coordination
